items.title: Hunt for Black Friday deals is steering toward record holiday spending
items.summary:
Shoppers are keeping especially busy this Black Friday, having already spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving Day, according to Adobe Analytics.

The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley are joined by Washington Crossing Advisors senior portfolio manager Chad Morganlander to discuss the forecasts for continued consumer spending through Cyber Monday.

items.title: U.S. Black Friday online sales set to exceed $13 billion, Adobe predicts
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. online spending on Black Friday is expected to exceed $13 billion, according to Adobe Analytics, as shoppers pursue holiday discounts amid persistent inflation and elevated gasoline prices.

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq End Best Week In Over A Year As AI Optimism Makes Comeback — VZ, ANT, ADBE, TSLA In Focus
items.summary: Meanwhile, the Dow Jones index recorded its best week since October 2022.

items.title: Amazon Stocks Climb 2.96% as Thanksgiving Online Spending Hits $7.1 Billion
items.summary: Adobe data shows U.S. shoppers beat forecasts on Thanksgiving Day, setting up a projected $12.9 billion Black Friday online.

items.title: Shopify Stocks Jump 6.05% as Record Online Holiday Spending Kicks Off
items.summary: Thanksgiving online sales of $7.1 billion beat Adobe's forecast, sending investors toward the platform behind many independent online stores.

items.title: Why Is Adobe (ADBE) Forecasting $47.5 Billion In Cyber Week Sales?
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS:ADBE) projects US$47.5b in global online sales for Cyber Week, covering Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday 2026. The projection is based on Adobe's analytics of digital transactions and trends across major retail platforms ahead of the holiday period. Adobe highlights artificial intelligence driven tools as an influence on pricing, personalization and promotion strategies for online retailers. Adobe's US$47.5b Cyber Week forecast fits into a wider pattern of e commerce and AI...

items.title: Adobe’s 33% 2026 Slide is Worth Buying Says Wall Street Analyst Predicting 60% Gains After Recent Re-Rating
items.summary: Adobe and Autodesk both beat estimates and raised guidance on AI demand, yet investors price them very differently. One bets on a billion users, the other on deep workflow lock-in, and a December report could decide which story wins.

items.title: ADBE Stock On Track For 4-Day Rally: Adobe Reports Surge In AI Traffic, $7.1B Thanksgiving Sales
items.summary: Adobe forecast $12.9 billion online sales on Black Friday, up 9.2% YoY and a record $15.1B on Cyber Monday, up 6.2% YoY in this year’s holiday spending.
